notes.title: Fly fishing, new fish species and waters, and other improvements
notes.content:
Almost a year has passed since the last update and it was time to bring a few improvements to the game. These are suggestions from players, but also our own ideas that could be implemented.
Originally, the update was supposed to be released in spring, but a tricky new fishing method took a little more time than planned:

[h1]Fly-Fishing[/h1]
In addition to float and bottom lead fishing, spinning, spoon fishing and pilk fishing, fly fishing has been completely absent up to now. Not without reason, because this fishing method is difficult to implement in games.
Now, however, it is possible to fish with a fly in (almost) all waters.
The choice is made at the start of each map - you can choose between 'normal' fishing or fly fishing.

This fishing method is still in its early stages and is therefore not yet available in competitions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/87dc98f41ef57a5b72f174caacb20712cdab5f8a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bait retrieval[/h1]
You can now speed up the retrieval of the bait considerably by pressing the Shift key in addition to the left mouse button!

[h1]Saving the rod setup[/h1]
The setting of each individual fishing rod can be saved from this version onwards.
The colour of the rod, the colour of the line, the choice of float, which lure etc. is saved by pressing 'G' and automatically set to this setting when you start the game the next day.
With 'Shift+G' the setting for the rod is reset to default.
This way you can permanently change any fishing rod with your favourite colours, pose and lure etc.!

[h1]New fish species[/h1]
- Deuterodon
- Twospot Astyanax
- Piapara
- Tararira (Wolf Fish)
- Flatwhiskered Catfish

[h1]New fishing waters[/h1]

notes.title: Many improvements, new fish species and venues
notes.content:
This update brings some improvements to the game.
Among other things, all maps have been revised because many fishing waters had problems with the sun in the morning and evening hours. The result is worth seeing!

On a trial basis, a subdivision of different fish species in different ponds has been implemented, which was not possible before (here in Finca Esperanza, Colombia).

Some bugs in the game statistics have been fixed. For example, there were always problems with double names such as eel and eel mother etc.

You can read about all the other changes in the game under "News / Changelog".

[h2]6 new fish species[/h2]
	- Bicuda
	- Blue Fish
	- Mahseer
	- Nelma
	- Skygazer
	- Vampire Fish

[h2]13 New Venues[/h2]
[h3]King-Mark-Caves(Guatemala)[/h3]
A park for visitors with several caves. However, the game is only about the small pond.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/bad171f7200ba00c19425a8682da2b7229c062f1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Rice Paddies(Vietnam)[/h2]
Very idyllic area with realistic looking mountains in the background.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/dc0b956fe34645ce07014e9d13ed307b66c084d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hue Citadel (Vietnam)[/h2]
A conversion from my other game "Eve of Destruction - REDUX Vietnam". Here without shooting, but with fishing possibilities. I always wanted to know what swims around in these channels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/27dd881d673406662bc5a2d0ba56452ed3b37a06.jpg[/img]

[h2]Beaver Lake(Canada)[/h2]
There are no beavers here, it is an artificial park with a pond. By the way, the swan is a pedal boat from which you can fish.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/0a05dae1f46a1f310f232975ada280fb59d7018e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Lake Condor(Peru)[/h2]
El Condor Pasa ːsteammockingː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/f4bd035d5e1143a1af0777b96148431b9f1bf1f1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Lake Buyan (Indonesia)[/h2]
Fish farming in a large lake. Fishing is possible both in the lake and in the fish breeding ponds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/4bdde826a5a3bf1acb7004c1eec0043ab44302e1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bora-Bora (Polynesia)[/h2]
With inshore and deep-sea fishing, beach beauties and a forgotten buried bather ːsteammockingː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/738e38b56e993e08b2434ff11da1567ff89b8dad.jpg[/img]

[h2]Rio Seco (Columbia)[/h2]
Very murky water due to soil erosion. Nevertheless beautiful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/fae420d12b9bd23ea4350cd721ad67ce38f47035.jpg[/img]

[h2]Rio Perquilauquen (Chile)[/h2]
Small river in Chile with a ferry and a football pitch.
It takes a bit of practice to kick a ball, but it is great fun to score beautiful goals ːsteammockingː.
If you prefer fishing, you can of course do it on the river or on the ferry.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/a048af63e814f3d6c5ea926a93aa425e954ad51f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Donez (Ukraine)[/h2]
Border river between Russia and Ukraine. In game you can see how it could work.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/a7c30941c4527b427e906d335f1df419b83be9a1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Finca Esperanza (Columbia)[/h2]
Pond system with different fish species per pond.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/81ce1d60a83b8fd09bc183027a1c5530bbc6f3f5.jpg[/img]

[h2]House Of The Rising Sun (Cambodia)[/h2]
According to the song of the same name, the house is in New Orleans, but here the sun shines so beautifully around the hut that the title simply had to be.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/e4a50f59773475510981c3b3660bd514c3709328.jpg[/img]

[h2]Namunyak (Kenya)[/h2]
Fishing waters with a lot of African flair ːsteammockingː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/55f42afd3e615fc58d956fac38335d8dedcbca5d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Post10 Perpetuation in Halls Pond (USA)[/h2]
Who doesn't know Post10? Be sure to search for him on YouTube and watch it!
I have set up a monument to him in the map "Halls Pond". With angry beavers and idiot with an excavator ːsteammockingː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/849e0a745a2d3c1fea2df45b16c8a6df72dffc13.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fascinating underwater world and the deadliest stream for cars
notes.content:
In addition to new features, there are a few new maps in the current version.

[h2]Competitions[/h2]
The competitions have been changed to a minimum of 2 days so that other players have a chance to participate. The short one-day version has been abolished.

New: the competition archive, where you can now also view the results of older competitions.

[h2]Aquarium[/h2]
An underwater world with many sights, various aquariums and, of course, fishing opportunities in game. However, fishing in the aquariums themselves is not possible, but there is a pool in the entrance area and sea fishing in the whale watching area!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/9f82ac965a63e60d3720429e8747dcaf74d44c4c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/011520cb55b50b757fc14ccd9745d3bd060257b4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/0daa6c1382e866656678e04e451e6e0d47b387f2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Rufford Ford, England[/h2]
A well-known route among motorists in the area runs through an often-flooded stream at Rufford Ford. On Youtube there are hundreds of videos worth watching of motorists wrecking their vehicles there, some of which are new!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/2f31250429fcdef6be190fc860f0baa445f83e7f.jpg[/img]
Fishing is available in the beautiful Rufford Lake behind the mill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/2cb6a7a93b11accbb33c9061551dcd37cea3dc71.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hallig, Germany[/h2]
Low tide and high tide are a special feature at this fishing water.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/be413f44f5865d086b4d1e19c69694173eb16a15.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bergtjaern, Sweden[/h2]
A small remote pond in the wilderness of Sweden.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/f0e0e002044b89eae514ca87f3671ad72ecba9ea.jpg[/img]

[h2]Kalandula Falls, Angola[/h2]
A very beautiful and large waterfall in Angola.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/e79b30df474a720e70e9533560a9adfd75d29e68.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mabwawani, Tanzania[/h2]
Also in Africa is this pond site.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/35a91f70ecd31d183eb9f2cd26155e8f086405e6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fishing in Space is now possible :)
notes.content:
This Update fixes some minor bugs and has some minor changes.
I.E. a message will pop up if you get near to usable boats.
A new banchmark-tool will show you some technical data about the game and the performance.

Here are the new venues:

[h2]Moldau, Czech[/h2]
Relaxing stretch of the Vltava River in the Czech Republic with meadows and fields and horses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/0cd297667893c3b7003c968414b9acc85a8acb65.jpg[/img]

[h2]Angkor Wat, Thailand[/h2]
Fishing directly at the world heritage site of the huge temple complex in Thailand.
Whether something swims in the pond?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/b589cc1defefa1be13bf9862d8a323482cd145f7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Venice, Italy[/h2]
It used to be the number 1 destination for wedding couples, now you can fish right from the gondola ːsteamhappyː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/5877cfcd38a9f500c96637ddaa7ab2189c7fa38f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ebro, Spain[/h2]
This river is an insider tip for walleye anglers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/0a72141f8277ea5982b23c45fde181e36cba0d28.jpg[/img]

[h2]Tambre, Spain[/h2]
Right next to an old power station flows the Tambre. The eels there do not tremble and the carp are not loaded either!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/f2ddcd9cd54b3fee5eb989daf97f6d5c5b041e85.jpg[/img]

[h2]Penedo Furado, Portugal[/h2]
Seems to be rather an Eldorado for swimmers, but in the game there is fishing allowed and bathing is prohibited ːsteammockingː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/c5eb94dbc9785b7b82ad593a4ee777939d73c484.jpg[/img]

[h1]Galaxies that no human has ever seen before[/h1]

[h2]Kepler-452b[/h2]
Don't ask how to get there. With today's rocket technology, the journey would take 26 million years! But no problem in the game - fishing on a far away exoplanet.
Since it is unknown which fish are on this planet and whether there is life there at all, the most primitive fish of the earth were used as a substitute. ːsteamhappyː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/7bcd1e4489b1d120e06208a9ad2e41ee06152cf7.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
This update fixes a few minor bugs.
New is an overview of all fishing waters, sorted by water name and by country.
Also there are 4 new venues in game.

Kiruna is located in the north of Sweden. In this map you can go fishing under the Aurora Borealis and listen to the singing ice. An impressive atmosphere.

[h2]Lake Klamm - Austria[/h2]
Lake Klamm is a beatiful place in the Alps in Austria. You can go fishing in the lake or a river under the weir.

notes.title: Apocalypse now!
notes.content:
[h2]Apocalypse now![/h2]
The world has been destroyed by comets and the zombie epidemic has swept mankind away.
29 weeks later you wake up from the coma and are the last survivor.
What do you do first?
A shelter - check.
Water - Check.
Search for food...
Of course the first thing to do is to go fishing and catch some fish for dinner ːsteamhappyː
4 new venues and 6 fish species are included in the new update.

[h2]Postapocalypse (Latvia)[/h2]
As mentioned above, this is a fictitious body of water in an apocalyptic scenario.
Creepy background noises and hitting comets provide for atmosphere.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/934d9602b61edf16eee605a8e8ff6e01b2d9c8aa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mercer Bayou (USA)[/h2]
A natural river landscape in Arkansas, USA.
This is where the legendary Bigfoot does his mischief.
So they say ːsteamhappyː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/a116b97c64d78a19cdf99b786b1982e1600c7f13.jpg[/img]

[h2]Thu Nga Fishing Pond (Vietnam)[/h2]
Beautiful pond in Vietnam near Hanoi.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/37307d898b62783469c4d42c3960c8ff1712045d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Lac des Allemands (USA)[/h2]
This jungle paradise is located in Loiusiana, USA, west of New Orleans.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/37c79c9081505ae1050dfb7b94344060b5cb637e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New: pilk fishing and Story-Mode
notes.content:
The new update brings 2 completely new fishing modes.

[h2]Story-Mode (experimental)[/h2]
You have to complete a variety of tasks, for example catch fish for a village feast or a big catfish and even use a pilk to detonate an old aircraft bomb.
There are no limits with the different stories ːsteamhappyː

At the moment the story mode is still 'experimental' because of course it hasn't been implemented for all waters yet and for later on a kind of evaluation with 'rewards' is planned.
But you can already try the new mode for some waters.

[h2]Pilk fishing from a fishing boat or cutter[/h2]
In addition to trolling, you can now go pilk fishing from a boat in most oceans.
Pilking can be optionally selected when starting the map.

[h1]New map: Fehmarnbelt (Germany)[/h1]
Try pilk fishing from a cutter on the (in Germany) famous "MS Anja", which starts from Heiligenhafen.
The real ship has a slightly different name, but it looks very similar to the real one ːsteamhappyː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/ccc6bdb8f327ad6f5692c2db6d819bf3bf6cfc39.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New features, fishes and venues
notes.content:
[h2]Update with many extensions and improvements[/h2]
Small splashes on water surface during casting and stroke, jumping fish that now jump at different places and different camera positions in boats (keys 1-0) are nice new features.
But much more extensive are changes in the main menu with new functions.

[h2]New submenu to select fishing waters[/h2]
All waters at a glance, sorted by water type, make the selection easier for beginners and advanced anglers.
Additionally, you can (by clicking on the dice) go to a randomly selected water.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/3404861625a75bcbfa3756604f7d7d4a050252af.jpg[/img]

[h2]Daily News[/h2]
In the 'News' section you can now find additional daily news, which are automatically created by the game. 
So every special feature is displayed, for example new world records, new casting records, especially big fish caught etc.

[h2]Tournaments[/h2]
There were performance problems in the competitions when the competition had been running for several days. This was simply because the many fish had to be evaluated at certain intervals and the more fish caught, the worse it was for performance.
This problem can now be avoided by switching off the HUD.

Furthermore, it is now possible to display the fish species of the water in competitions (key F2).

[h2]New fish species and new 3D models[/h2]
Newly added are the octopus and the stingray, which can be found in oceans all over the world.
The ray in game is representative of the hundreds of ray species that exist around the globe.
For a few species of fish the 3D models were exchanged for better ones. So for the ugly Nase there is finally a much better model available.
Also Rockfish and Piranha have been exchanged for new -animated- 3D models!

[h2]New venue: Volga (Russia)[/h2]
A heavily overgrown small side arm of the Volga. With frog ːsteamhappyː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/89dca551846681ed09b56e596e00f94c5b8258f5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/dba28828aebdc09bbdebfa22e509f024a2f25c8b.jpg[/img]

[h2]New venue: Sainte Marie (Madagascar)[/h2]
An island with a lot of space and a correspondingly fast boat, with which you can get to the desired fishing spot in minutes. With spoiler ːsteamhappyː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/b078f733b472ee574036f90c7d74696f13c56a6d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/2452df1475b9bf921f2836192cba7d71f8194782.jpg[/img]

[h2]New venue: Big Game (Finnland)[/h2]
This scene is based on the film of the same name 'Big Game', in which Airforce One is shot down over Finland by terrorists and a 15 year old boy takes care of the VIP.
With a fishing president and a usable mobile freezer. ːsteamhappyː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/cf4ad61c5aecea076b8f89905765d48f63effecf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/55936adaee98987436be062f6fd3a5a831ea634a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New music, new venues in Argentina and Canada and much more
notes.content:
[h2]Music by Julia Westlin[/h2]
Really dreamlike music by Julia Westlin comes into the game with the new version (Radio - key R).
Julia is an independent musician, songwriter and painter from Sweden.
At this point I would like to thank Julia for her support and the permission to use the music in game!
Please support Julia with many thumbs up on Youtube.
https://www.youtube.com/user/JuliaWestlin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/08cd5b5a99b6d0bb9e512f91724ca369fac15fbe.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Setups[/h2]
Especially for river fishing a setup without float was introduced. This allows you to let the lure drift in the stream. In levels 4 and 5 without additional bite indicator you have to keep an eye on the line to see the bite - just like in real fishing!
This setup is the last in the group of floats, just 1 before the sinker!

For bottom fishing additional beep sounds have been added for the 'electronic bite indicator'.
Furthermore, a control beep is made immediately after the cast.

[h2]Predators on the prowl[/h2]
We know it from the water: hundreds of small breeding fish flee in panic to the water surface and create eddies. Predatory fish are hunting here! For anglers a sign to unpack the blinker :)
This effect is now also in game and can cause a frightening moment every now and then.

[h2]Bats[/h2]
At the last competition in Bodiam Castle, England, I was fishing at night and I saw this spotlight illuminating the castle. My first thought was: 'there should be bats flying around'.
And bam! Now there are bats flying, which looks really good :)
It has nothing to do with fishing, but it lifts the atmosphere.

[h2]lbs und inch[/h2]
The game is based with it's statistics on the metric system with grams and centimeters, which is used worldwide. 
In the USA and a few other countries it is not so common yet. That's why now when you catch a fish, lbs and inches (pounds and inches) are displayed in addition!
But this only applies to the catch display! To change the complete statistic system would be much too complex and would be the source of too many errors.

[h2]New map: Frank Falls, Canada[/h2]
Atmospheric map in the wilderness of Canada.
Must be seen by day and especially at night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/dcb7f22c07b68a04a54eada0af41bda54a884513.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/649bab8a6a2a8ae52411c74e68c17b7644ced556.jpg[/img]

[h2]New map: Rio Salado, Argentina[/h2]
The name says it all: Rio Salado.
Here you don't fish in the cloudy, but in salad :)
Not bad!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/22d59ffde596fa3f20a8b8141e4cf0470b170e05.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/2383b6265ebf62fa84508e3a7bad312dd526cad7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update to v1.0.129
notes.content:
[h1]Namoi River, Walgett, Australia[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/71c5ae3574936350790f83f7cd83ba26dc117757.jpg[/img]
This is a river in Australia, wich meanwhile is dry most of the time.
In addition to fish, kangaroos, emus, wild boars and more can be seen here ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Sauer, Luxembourg[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34902287/f247cec41d675fd9c76b1fc1e8562a870813db52.jpg[/img]
The Sauer is a river in Luxembourg that offers a high biodiversity.
Even salmon and sea trout are present!

[h1]Changes with fishing[/h1]
The rotation speed of the rod (to the fish) has been increased, which makes the drill look more realistic.

[h1]Changes with tournaments[/h1]
The two-hour competition had to be cancelled without replacement due to unfairness in the evaluation. With these short competitions it was too easy to push yourself up the list of cup winners. 
As a result, these competitions will no longer be evaluated and will be removed for the future.
So you can now only create competitions between 1 - 7 days.

[h1] Bugfixes in competitions[/h1]
Unfortunately, there was a translation problem in the competitions, which is why some turneys were displayed incorrectly or not at all. This bug is now fixed!

notes.title: Tournaments, Mini-Map, new venues and fishes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34902287/d2b6a88551098b1c51c3ae729d4813364574795a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Tournaments[/h1]
The new version (v1.0.089) comes with a tournament system and you can now fish against friends and others all around the world.
Note: each player can start one competition within 7 days.
Select from different variables to create your own tournament and play with other peopler.

[h1]Mini-Map[/h1]
For a better orientation a Mini-Map system was added.
The mini-map can be resized and you now can see where you are.

[h1]New fishes[/h1]
4 new fishes were added for the oversized Lake Fork, USA, Texas.
All 4 are the so called 'Muskellunge' in different variants.
(Pike-like fishes ːsteamhappyː)

[h1]New Venues[/h1]
As announced before a very big lake in USA was added to the game.
Lake Fork has 315 miles / 507 km shoreline and there's enough space to fish.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34902287/8174cfb753f77fe60d3e6f9ba0c2486b83847b70.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34902287/0107f80d0e2c06067b5f119199985a224d03dbb8.jpg[/img][/url]

Also new is the map 'Rhein Vuile Gat' in the Netherlands, wich comes with salt- and freshwater fish.
The scene is placed in the Rhine-Delta.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34902287/bf2a11f3c16e669ed316fa5fc3eeeaa3bfa8751e.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34902287/c7d7a57f8b9bf2e767cb637eb45326fa0bd1c081.jpg[/img][/url]

Hungary also has got a new venue wich is called 'Danube near Budapest'.

And last but not least: icefishing in Russia. The map is placed at the Baikal Lake and you can fish for perch and pikes in a small ice-hole.
This map has a nice atmosphere. Don't forget to put on your wintercoat before fishing!

notes.title: Version 1.0.078 with a lot of new features
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34902287/6d39b166a9f35f2893cd793d7e8f4e430ca3ff26.jpg[/img]
In addition to eliminating a few smaller bugs there are 3 new fishing waters in game:
[list]
[*]Lake Brienz (Lake in Switzerland)
[*]Maguare (a small pond in Colombia)
[*]Theiss Lake (Lake in Hungary, here just a part of it!)
[/list]
In Norway - Faerder Lighthouse - the deep sea fishing was added.
It works just like in previous deep-sea fishing maps like Tanzania 
and Fiji!

In addition, you can now catch the following new fish species:
[list]
[*]East/North Sea: Flounder, Halibut, Common Dab, Turbot, Pollock, Saithe, Common Ling and Porbeagle!
[*]Europe: Vimba Bream, White-Eye and Linear Carp.
  For Europe a bug with the Crucian Carp and Bullhead was eliminated, wich prevented that these species could be caught.
[*]Asia: Grass carp and Pacu
[*]North America: American Shad
[*]South America: Traira (Tigerfish), Skipjack Tuna, Dourado
[/list]
If you want to perfect your fishing, you can choice fish bait for specific fish species.

In addition to new plastic fishes and -frog, blinkers and pilker there is now a selection of baits for floats and sinkers.
Worm, corn, maggots, boilies, dough, bread, various types of nut, cheese, cherry, strawberry, bacon, beetle, spider and bait fish for targeted fishing on specific fish species.

It is important to know that the choice of bait reduces the number of possible catches (!) and only to thetargeted fish will bite.
An example: Nuts are mainly used for Orfe and Chub.  All other fishes will hardly or not bite at all! 
So it will take much longer to catch something, but the desired species of fish will be on the hook.
The individual baits are described in game.

Another news is the setting of the field of view in game.
You can set it between 40-70°, standard is 50° (so far 60°).
This gives you a much better view on floats.
'F' changes the value (it's also discribed in the box with the shortcuts).

At the request of some players, the rate at which fish get off from the hook and strikes fail were increased.
So the game gets a little closer to reality. However, this rate is just been carefully adjusted!

And last but not least: The animations of the rods during the drill were smoothed, that means they don't 'flutter' anymore.

notes.title: First Update released
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34902287/3c00573eed3155b5751bde334b8bd5f2f1ed0df1.jpg[/img]
Today the first update was released.
It will fix a performance problem with the statistics and comes with the new [b]Hall of Fames[/b]. Learn more in game under 'News'!

And french language was added to the game.

[code]
CHANGELOG

        GENERAL
	-------
	- added french language
	- added fish picture to species world records statistics

	BUG FIXES
	---------
	- fixed performance problems and too much traffic with the statistics
	- fixed a display bug when a Barracuda was caught
	- fixed cast bug on an invisible collider 
	  in Lago Do Morai (Brasil) and 
	  Augusta Margaret River (Australia)
	- fixed a bug where (very small) fishes got minus score
	
	MAP CHANGES
	-----------
	- Lago Do Marai (Brasil): added some lights for better night atmosphere
	- Mbala Island (Sambia): added some lights for better night atmosphere
	- Faerder Lighthouse (Norway): darkened the daylight water[/code]
